title: Eat-Man
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Bolt Crank, the 'World's Greatest Mercenary', wanders a desert sci-fi world eating machines and objects, then reproducing them from his right arm when needed (ANN synopsis via AniList; MangaUpdates). Mostly episodic jobs, with a later arc about his past with Leon Field, a man called Shadow who controls machines, and Stella, a woman who wants to mechanize every human.
life_message: It holds up quiet competence and keeping one's word as a loner who helps people along the way (to verify).
